    "Overwhelming interface with a steep learning curve for new users",
    "Performance issues like lag or slow loading times",
    "Difficulty in quickly setting up and utilizing for a self-employed individual"

  "overall_experience": "This self-employed PTM found ClickUp to be a powerful tool with extensive functionality for project collaboration, appreciating its customization options. However, the sheer breadth of features and the complexity of the interface during a free trial period led to a frustrating and overwhelming experience. The learning curve and occasional performance issues hindered their ability to quickly adapt it for their specific needs, making them hesitant to commit to a paid plan."
